			}
			FROM = { set_state_flag = NSR_settling }
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hold_st_p30
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 30 }
					NSR_state_hold_change = yes
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_settle_after
		}
		remove_effect = {
			FROM = { clr_state_flag = NSR_settling }
			if = {
				limit = {
					FROM = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						check_variable = { NSR_hold > 49 }
					}
				}
				FROM = { add_core_of = ROOT }
			}
			else = {
				custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_settle_failed
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 5
		}
